title: Cross-tenant Just-In-Time provisioning and compliance evidence flow
creator: Priya Narang
description: Implement a Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning flow that supports cross-tenant SAML assertions and SCIM deprovisioning, emits tamper-evident access evidence for residency-bound tenants, and plugs into the periodic access review pipeline. Goal: reduce standing privileged accounts, speed onboarding for low-risk roles, and provide machine-readable artifacts for auditors (residency-aware exports).
acceptance_criteria: SAML-based JIT flow provisions minimal RBAC roles for new SSO logins and records provisioning events to the evidence store
SCIM deprovision events reconcile with RBAC and flag mismatches for review within 24 hours
Evidence export includes tenant residency metadata, action provenance (who/when/from-where), and is signed for tamper-proofing
Periodic access review UI can import JIT/SCIM event traces and annotate action items; reviewers can mark remediation steps
End-to-end tests simulate cross-region login and validate that routing respects tenant residency policies and that evidence is stored in the correct regional store
tasks: Design SAML assertion mapping to tenant-scoped RBAC roles (security review required)
Build SCIM connector enhancements to emit structured deprovisioning reasons and request IDs
Extend evidence service to attach residency tags and sign JSON exports with KMS key per-region
Add webhook from evidence service to access-review queue and implement idempotent replay
Instrument metrics: provisioning latency, deprovision lag, evidence export size and retention counts
Create e2e test harness (staging) and synthetic traffic generator for canary runs

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cross-tenant JIT could accidentally provision overly broad roles if assertions are mis-mapped. Mitigation: default to least-privilege role and require explicit MFA for elevation.
Risk: Evidence export might violate residency if signed and stored in wrong region. Mitigation: add region-origin header and KMS per-region enforcement in evidence-service.
Risk: SCIM deprovision lag causing stale access during periodic reviews. Mitigation: add reconciliation job and alert when lag > 24h
